findings.title: Obligation as a Tied Structure
findings.claim: Fulfilling contracts can be read as bringing a tied obligation through to intact completion, not merely performing an isolated task.
findings.mechanism: The focus carriers for fulfillment and contracts contact the native confirmed-covenant and fastening occurrences; the relation moves from binding to an endpoint at which performance is complete.
findings.reader_payoff: The opening command becomes a durable relation with both tension and a recognizable endpoint.
findings.containment: This is a native macro resonance, not a claim that every contract is a literal knot or that the physical image replaces the legal sense.

epistemic.reason: The focus branches and the 5:7 covenant occurrence are supplied by trusted packet evidence and meet through distinct carriers and triggers.

findings.containment: The 5:8 contact supplies a governing discipline for the focus judgment; it does not collapse adjudication, testimony, equity, and equivalence into one lexical sense.

epistemic.reason: All cited channel supports and native context occurrences are trusted, and each source-image branch has a distinct 5:8 carrier and trigger.

findings.claim: The covenant is kept through a whole public posture: obedient speech, straight witness, impartial judgment, and restraint of the hand when hostility invites breach.
findings.mechanism: The attributed HFT trace returns from the focus contract carrier to the confirmed covenant in 5:7, the even witness in 5:8, and the extended and restrained hands in 5:11.
findings.reader_payoff: The opening command becomes bodily and public: fulfillment is visible in speech, judgment, and the refusal to turn hostility into action.
findings.containment: The hand sequence may be thematic choreography rather than a direct lexical gloss on contracts; unresolved HFT branches remain attributed.

epistemic.reason: The exact native coordinates and returns are supplied, but the HFT synthesis across covenant, witness, and hands is legacy_unbound and partly inferential.

branch_activations.carrier: The attributed extended-hand occurrence carries threatened aggression reaching toward another.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The following restrained-hand occurrence turns that movement back.
branch_activations.activation: The bodily hand sequence contacts the focus contract as a visible test of whether hostility breaks the bond.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Covenant fidelity includes restraint of force.
branch_activations.boundary: The unresolved branch supplies no independent gloss.

branch_activations.facet_statement: even justice
branch_activations.carrier: The native 5:8 justice occurrence carries even justice under hostility.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus contract carrier supplies the bond whose conduct must be kept.
branch_activations.activation: Even justice contacts covenant fidelity by preventing hatred from bending the public measure.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Fulfilling the covenant includes impartial judgment.
branch_activations.boundary: The source image does not turn the focus noun into the word for justice.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Uçlar veya parçalar bir araya getirilir ve düğümle sabitlenir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus contract carrier carries the image of parts joined and fixed.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 5:8 supplies impartial justice and 5:11 supplies the threatened hand.
branch_activations.activation: The joined-bond carrier meets public judgment and force, making covenant keeping an embodied discipline.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The contract bond must remain joined through judgment and bodily restraint.
branch_activations.boundary: The HFT trace does not prove a direct grammatical relation between the focus noun and every later act.

branch_activations.carrier: The attributed straight-measure occurrence carries public equity as the standard for witness.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The repeated justice occurrence makes the standard active under animus.
branch_activations.activation: The straight measure contacts the contract carrier by specifying how the bond is publicly honored.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Covenant fulfillment includes straight witness.
branch_activations.boundary: The unresolved branch is retained at the HFT role only.

branch_activations.carrier: The attributed restrained-hand occurrence carries prevention of the aggressive movement.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The extended hand supplies the hostile action that must be stopped.
branch_activations.activation: Restraint contacts the covenant carrier as the bodily preservation of a bond under threat.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The covenant is kept by turning force away from breach.
branch_activations.boundary: No claim is made that every act of restraint is covenantal.

branch_activations.facet_statement: a firm covenant
branch_activations.carrier: The native 5:7 occurrence carries a firm covenant confirmed by the community.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus contract carrier supplies the opening command to fulfill bonds.
branch_activations.activation: The firm covenant gives the later speech, justice, and hand acts a common public frame.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Fulfillment is an embodied posture within a firm covenant.
branch_activations.boundary: The HFT synthesis remains qualified and does not replace the plain command.

findings.title: The Bond Held Inwardly
findings.claim: The contract carrier also permits an inward commitment reading when the native covenant is paired with knowledge of what is held in the breasts.
findings.mechanism: The focus contract occurrence contacts the 5:7 confirmed covenant, its hear-and-obey response, and the stated interior locus of knowledge.
findings.reader_payoff: The command reaches beyond external paperwork to the settled commitment that makes public fulfillment durable.
findings.containment: This is an additional native focus activation, not a claim that legal obligation is reducible to private feeling or that the inner state is unverifiable.

epistemic.reason: The focus branch and all 5:7 carriers are directly supplied; the inward extension remains bounded by the native covenant scene.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: bir düşünceye gönülden bağlanıp onda kararlı kalma
branch_activations.facet_statement: Gönül bir düşünce veya görüş üzerinde sabitlenir ve ondan dönmemeye yönelir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus al-ʿuqūd carrier can carry a bond of settled inward commitment.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 5:7 joins the confirmed covenant and hear-and-obey response to knowledge of what is in the breasts.
branch_activations.activation: Interior steadiness contacts the covenant carrier and shows why public fulfillment is more than external form.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The command can be heard as requiring a bond held inwardly and enacted outwardly.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not psychologize the legal command or make inner feeling its sole content.

findings.title: Recitation as Followed Instruction
findings.claim: The exception introduced by the recitation carrier can be heard as instruction that is received in sequence and then followed.
findings.mechanism: The focus passive recitation occurrence contacts the 5:7 hearing-and-obeying response, so what is recited becomes a rule carried into conduct.
findings.reader_payoff: The phrase about what is recited gains procedural force: the exception is not an unexplained interruption but an instruction to be followed.
findings.containment: The native contact supports following as a contextual extension; it does not claim that recitation alone settles every legal detail.

epistemic.reason: The focus carrier, exact QAC return, and 5:7 hearing-and-obeying occurrences are supplied in the packet.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Kutsal kitap sözleri, bir parça diğerini izleyecek biçimde okunur.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus yutlā carrier carries sacred words read in sequence, one following another.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 5:7 pairs hearing with obedience as the community's response.
branch_activations.activation: Sequential recitation contacts hear-and-obey and gives the exception a follow-through in conduct.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The recited limits are heard as instructions that govern the next act.
branch_activations.boundary: The finding does not claim that every recited phrase is a complete legal code.

findings.title: Judgment That Finds the Right Course
findings.claim: The judgment carrier can also be perceived as the exercise of knowledge and discernment that finds the right course.
findings.mechanism: The focus judgment occurrence contacts 5:7's knowledge occurrence and its interior locus, adding discernment to the binding-decision frame.
findings.reader_payoff: The closing judgment is newly visible as informed protection rather than an arbitrary interruption of the permissions.
findings.containment: The branch distinguishes knowledge-guided discernment from judicial decision without replacing the latter or importing a separate source.

epistemic.reason: The focus Hkm branch and exact 5:7 knowledge occurrences are native packet evidence.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: bilgi ve usla doğruyu bulma yetkinliği
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bilgi ve us, kişinin doğruyu yanlıştan ayırıp doğru olana ulaşmasını sağlar.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus yaḥkumu carrier carries judgment and holding back from a harmful course.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 5:7 supplies knowledge and the inner locus in which discernment is known.
branch_activations.activation: Knowledge-guided discernment contacts judgment and makes the ruling intelligible as a right-course decision.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The final clause can be read as judgment informed by the ability to distinguish and reach what is right.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus branch is not reduced to learned information or technical skill.

findings.title: The Exception Makes a Boundary
findings.claim: The focus exception carrier gains a repeated boundary-making force from the native prohibitions and permissions in 5:3 and 5:5.
findings.mechanism: The focus ghayr occurrence contacts the repeated native ghayr occurrences that exclude specific cases from otherwise stated food or relation permissions.
findings.reader_payoff: The exception is felt as a deliberate contour around the lawful field rather than a loose afterthought.
findings.containment: The finding concerns the boundary-making function of the repeated carrier; it does not claim that the two native exceptions have identical referents.

epistemic.reason: The focus and native repeated exception coordinates are explicitly supplied, with direct pericope connections to 5:3 and 5:5.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: başka olma, dışta bırakma veya olumsuzlama
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şeyin belirtilen başka bir şeyle aynı olmayıp ondan ayrı, başka veya ona aykırı olması temel ilişkidir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus ghayr carrier establishes a relation of otherness and separation.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 5:3 and 5:5 repeat ghayr while marking excluded cases inside legal sequences.
branch_activations.activation: Repeated native exclusion contacts the focus carrier and gives otherness a boundary-making role.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The verse's exception is heard as an intentional exclusion that protects the stated permission from overextension.
branch_activations.boundary: The activation does not equate the focus exception with every later exception.

findings.title: Mercy Around the Judge
findings.claim: The automatic basmala places the focus naming of Allah inside a mercy frame before the verse presents judgment and will.
findings.mechanism: The focus Allah carrier contacts the automatic 5:0 naming occurrence and its paired mercy attributes, so the later governing clause is preceded by a mercy-bearing frame.
findings.reader_payoff: The verse's authority is encountered within a remembered relation of mercy rather than as an isolated legal force.
findings.containment: The automatic basmala is host-surah context, not an external overlay; the frame qualifies the reading without deciding the content of every judgment.

epistemic.reason: The packet explicitly marks 5:0 as automatic host basmala context and supplies the Allah and paired mercy occurrences.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: Yaratıcıya özgü ad ile seslenme ve ant biçimleri
branch_activations.facet_statement: Dalın merkezinde, Yaratıcıyı başkalarından ayırarak gösteren ve yalnız ona özgü sayılan özel ad bulunur.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus Allah carrier names the Creator as the distinct addressee of the ruling.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The automatic basmala supplies the paired raḥmān and raḥīm mercy occurrences.
branch_activations.activation: The named judge contacts the mercy frame before the verse's judgment and will clause.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The authority of the closing clause is heard within a prior mercy-bearing address.
branch_activations.boundary: The basmala does not erase the verse's restrictions or determine a legal outcome by itself.

findings.title: Faith as Enacted Obedience
findings.claim: The opening address to believers can be heard as enacted acceptance because the native covenant response joins faith with hearing and obedience.
findings.mechanism: The focus āmanū carrier contacts the 5:7 hearing-and-obeying response and the 5:9 faith-and-deeds occurrence, making belief visible in the conduct that follows.
findings.reader_payoff: The addressees are perceived not only as people holding a proposition but as a community whose acceptance is tested in action.
findings.containment: This is a native contextual activation of the acceptance branch; it does not deny inward belief or reduce faith to works alone.

epistemic.reason: The focus faith carrier and the native 5:7 and 5:9 occurrences are explicitly supplied.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Temel cekirdek bir haberin, sozun veya hakikatin dogru sayilmasidir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus āmanū carrier carries accepting a report, word, or truth as true.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 5:7 joins hearing to obedience and 5:9 joins faith to righteous action.
branch_activations.activation: The acceptance carrier contacts enacted response and gives the opening address a behavioral horizon.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Belief is heard as acceptance that moves into obedient fulfillment.
branch_activations.boundary: The activation does not claim that outward action exhausts faith.

findings.title: A Horizon of Final Accounting
findings.claim: The external 1:4 overlay gives the focus judgment a specific horizon of final accounting without replacing its native legal frame.
findings.mechanism: The focus judgment carrier contacts the external day and religion occurrences in the added ayah, changing an immediate ruling into one that can also be perceived against final accountability.
findings.reader_payoff: The closing judgment clause opens toward the question of what measure ultimately governs the permitted and forbidden.
findings.containment: This is an external overlay only; 1:4 does not determine the legal details of 5:1 or turn every native judgment into an eschatological statement.

epistemic.reason: The external ayah and focus judgment occurrence are supplied, but the horizon is a second-phase contextual inference.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Karar verme, bir durumun belirli biçimde olduğunu ya da olmadığını saptamaya da uzanır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus judgment carrier includes determining a matter as one thing or another.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The added 1:4 names the day and the governing religion of final accounting.
branch_activations.activation: Final-accounting language contacts determination and supplies a farther horizon for the focus judgment.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The ruling can be perceived as belonging to an order whose measures culminate in accountability.
branch_activations.boundary: No afterlife detail is imported beyond the supplied day-and-religion contact.

findings.title: The Judge as Worshipful Addressee
findings.claim: The external 1:5 overlay makes the Allah named in 5:1 perceptible as the one toward whom worship and dependence are directed.
findings.mechanism: The focus divine-name carrier contacts the added declaration of worship and seeking aid, turning the legal addressee into an invoked relation rather than a detached name.
findings.reader_payoff: The command is heard as addressed within a worshipful dependence on the one who governs the permitted.
findings.containment: The overlay adds address and dependence, not a new legal rule or a claim that the focus name lexically means worship.

epistemic.reason: The external worship-and-aid occurrences and the focus Allah carrier are supplied, while their relation is an overlay inference.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Temel eylem, bir varlığa tapınmak ve kişinin kendini bu tapınmaya vermesidir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus Allah carrier names the one to whom the ruling is attributed.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The added 1:5 joins worship with asking for aid.
branch_activations.activation: Worshipful dependence contacts the named addressee and makes the legal command part of an addressed relation.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The judge of the focus verse is also encountered as the worshipful source of aid.
branch_activations.boundary: The overlay does not alter the surface meaning of the legal command.

findings.title: Will as Direction Toward the Straight Path
findings.claim: The external 1:6 overlay gives the focus will carrier a guidance direction toward a straight and upright path.
findings.mechanism: The focus yurīdu occurrence contacts the added request for guidance to the straight path, so willing is perceived as orientation toward a course rather than abstract desire.
findings.reader_payoff: The closing will clause gains a directional quality that complements the verse's ordered permissions and limits.
findings.containment: The overlay supplies direction, not a replacement translation of yurīdu or a claim that 1:6 explains every divine aim.

epistemic.reason: The external guidance and straight-path occurrences are supplied and contact the resolved focus will carrier, but the transfer is second-phase contextual inference.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir seyi dilemek ve benligin o seye dogru yonelmesidir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus yurīdu carrier carries willing and the self's orientation toward an aim.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The added 1:6 asks for guidance to a straight and upright path.
branch_activations.activation: Guidance supplies a concrete direction for the focus will carrier.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The closing will is perceived as aimed movement toward an ordered path.
branch_activations.boundary: The overlay does not claim that the word itself contains the full theology of guidance.

findings.title: Exception on the Guided Path
findings.claim: The external 1:7 overlay gives the focus exception carrier a path-shaped contrast between the granted way and the ways marked by anger or error.
findings.mechanism: The focus ghayr occurrence contacts the added path, blessing, anger, and straying occurrences, so exclusion becomes a guard around a desired direction.
findings.reader_payoff: The exception clause is newly perceptible as protecting a path from named counter-directions.
findings.containment: This overlay does not import the whole of Fatiha into 5:1; it retains only the exact path-and-exclusion contact in 1:7.

epistemic.reason: The focus exception and all cited 1:7 occurrences are supplied, but the path-shaped synthesis is external overlay evidence.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: başka olma, dışta bırakma veya olumsuzlama
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şeyin belirtilen başka bir şeyle aynı olmayıp ondan ayrı, başka veya ona aykırı olması temel ilişkidir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus ghayr carrier establishes otherness and exclusion.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The added 1:7 contrasts the blessed path with anger and straying.
branch_activations.activation: The exclusion carrier contacts the path contrast and makes the exception a guard against counter-directions.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The lawful field can be heard as marked off from paths that depart into anger or error.
branch_activations.boundary: The overlay does not identify the focus exception with all possible theological uses of ghayr.

friction_notes: The native context surfaces provide exact ayah and root-occurrence coordinates, but the packet does not supply full target morphology for every context occurrence; those carriers remain qualified at the contextual level.

The four HFT candidates are legacy_unbound. Their supplied coordinates and focus returns agree with the packet, so they are retained as attributed activations; unresolved branch records keep facet_id, branch_gloss, and facet_statement null.

The explicit external overlay was reviewed only after native discovery. External 1:2 and 1:3 add no retained delta beyond the native Allah and automatic-basmalah mercy frame, while 1:7's blessing material does not add a separate native blessing carrier; the retained external findings therefore use only the specific contacts in 1:4, 1:5, 1:6, and 1:7.
The findings are an evidence-complete docket and are not ranked. Repeated focus carriers may land in separate findings because their triggers and resulting readings are materially distinct.
